concerns.text: FR-001 (download Materials Project data) has no associated task. The plan omits Materials Project loading and only mentions a waiver, but the waiver is not recorded as a formal spec amendment, leaving the requirement uncovered.

FR-002 requires clustering descriptors computed *within the grain‑boundary interface* after impurity insertion. All descriptor tasks (T005) compute them on the bulk configuration before insertion, so the spec‑stated requirement is not satisfied.

FR-003 calls for extracting segregation‑energy measurements from published atomistic simulation records. The pipeline (T006) generates energies with an EAM potential instead of extracting literature values, leaving the requirement unmet.

FR-011 mandates validation of EAM‑derived energies against a DFT benchmark of ≥30 samples. Task T011 records a `[DATA_UNAVAILABLE]` status and the plan documents a waiver, but the waiver is not a formal spec amendment, so the required validation step is missing.
SC-006 (validation MAE ≤ 0.1 eV) depends on FR‑011. Because FR‑011 is not covered, the success‑criterion SC‑006 also lacks any task.

The quickstart guide (referenced in the plan) lists user‑facing steps, but no tasks are explicitly linked to those steps (e.g., “run the pipeline”, “inspect the results”). This leaves the quickstart elements without traceable tasks.
